h: Burna Boy headlines halftime at the NFL's first regular-season game in Paris
p: Burna Boy performed at halftime of the Steelers and Saints game at the Stade de France, the first regular-season NFL game staged in Paris. The show follows his 2025 headline night at the same stadium, when he became the first African artist to do so.
more: The league announced him as the Paris halftime act in September.
It was one of seven halftime shows across this season's international games.
Ayra Starr is billed for the London game.
